build_pml_params: build a PMLParams dataclass to store perfectly matched layer grid dimensions and absorption parameters
apply_uniaxial_pml_tensors: apply uniaxial PML to an isotropic permittivity array and generate anisotropic permittivity and permeability tensor elements
crop_and_pad_pml_region: crop the trailing dimensions of a permittivity array and apply edge padding for the PML region
compute_normalized_distance_into_pml: compute the normalized distance into the PML layer in terms of array elements for a given shape and widths
register_pml_params_pytree: register the PMLParams dataclass as a JAX pytree node to enable JIT compilation support
